property_summary: For any callee that may either succeed or revert, the reference contract's forward(...) call returns (does not revert) exactly when the low-level call to callee succeeds; the mutant inverts the require so it reverts on a successful callee call (breaking this correspondence) — so the rule: forward returns iff the callee's low-level call succeeds.
change_summary: Invert the require condition to require failure, causing forward to revert on success and proceed on failure — observable behavioral change.
